richmond.linePrev: Put your faith to the test when I tore off your dress
richmond.lineNext: But I sobered up and I swore off that stuff
stanza: Put your faith to the test when I tore off your dress
But I sobered up and I swore off that stuff
And the old lovers sing, "I thought it'd be me
But home was a dream, one I'd never seen

richmond.songTitle: The Night They Drove Old Dixie Down
richmond.linePrev: In the winter of '65, we were hungry, just barely alive
richmond.line: By May the tenth, Richmond had fell
richmond.lineNext: It's a time I remember, oh so well
stanza: Virgil Caine is the name, and I served on the Danville train
'Til Stonewall's cavalry came and tore up the tracks again
In the winter of '65, we were hungry, just barely alive
By May the tenth, Richmond had fell
It's a time I remember, oh so well
